name: ROOMMATE DHOONDO
tagline: Find your next roommate at VIT.
description: A roommate matching site for VIT students. Browse rooms by configuration with search filters, then connect through the built-in chat or shared contact details.
imageAlt: Roommate Dhoondo sign-in screen: an illustrated student surrounded by profile pictures, beside the email and password form.

name: ENROLLMENT PORTAL
description: MFC's enrollment portal. Applicants pick their domains, complete tasks and answer questions to reach the interview rounds.
imageAlt: Enrollment Portal sign-in page in orange pixel type reading Mozilla Firefox is recruiting, with a pixel dinosaur running along the bottom.

name: TECH WARS
tagline: Gravitas flagship. Capture territory. Hold it.
description: The Gravitas team game built by MFC's dev team. Teams solve riddles, then capture and defend territory points on a battlefield map.
imageAlt: Tech Wars login screen: team name, lobby ID and password fields inside a neon blue frame over a starfield with planets.

name: SOTY
tagline: A campus-wide treasure hunt, run from a phone.
description: MFC's annual treasure hunt. Teams scan QR codes across campus, solve clues and play bonus games, all inside the website.
imageAlt: Scavenger of the Year sign-in page with the raccoon logo and username and password fields on a purple gradient.

name: CODE TO SURVIVE
tagline: An escape room written in code.
description: A Gravitas event that turns quizzes into an interactive trail of clues, played as a virtual escape room.
imageAlt: Code To Survive entry screen: a corkboard of case files tied with red string, a welcome note and an Enter button.
